observations_after_inspection: Low shrubs and pale grass tufts stand well apart from one another.
Much stony bare ground shows between the plants: the cover is sparse, which is consistent with vegetation limited by water.
The same sparse cover continues to the horizon. One photograph (April 2006) cannot establish annual rainfall or rule out season, grazing or other disturbance.
independent_solution: widely spaced shrubs and tufts with bare stony ground (1)
one image/date: no rainfall total; season or grazing possible (1)
